name: Liont
description: A smith cured of the werewolf curse by the Cursemute, who wakes to find he has slaughtered his family and is killed by an angel.

timeline.summary: Liont, cured of lycanthropy by the Cursemute, wakes to an ordinary-seeming day while his wife and children repeat a warning not to open the door when it is knocked.
timeline.quote: Liont. When the door is knocked, do not open it.

timeline.summary: Liont opens the door in his mind and sees his house as it truly is, bloody, with Hilde dead on the bed.
timeline.quote: He looked at the body of Hilde, her face frozen in terror as she lay unmoving on the bed.

timeline.summary: Liont realizes he is the one who did this, despite believing he was free of the curse, and prays to Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Who had done this? He knew who had done this.

timeline.summary: A winged figure, perhaps Avacyn, blasts the roof off and strikes Liont with a lance of energy.
timeline.quote: She pointed her spear at him, and the tip grew bright, brighter, brighter than the sun overhead, and a lancing energy struck him in the chest, burning away clothes and skin.

timeline.summary: Refusing his plea for mercy, the angel kills Liont.

relations.note: The angel who strikes him down is perhaps Avacyn herself.

pages_say.description: A smith cured of the werewolf curse by the Cursemute, who wakes to find he has slaughtered his family and is killed by an angel.
